---
name: Bug or reproducibility report
about: Report a technical, scientific-contract or documentation problem
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Area

Installation / configuration / analysis / extension / report / documentation

## Environment

- lisaR version or commit:
- Operating system:
- R version and `sessionInfo()`:
- Relevant optional packages:

## Minimal safe reproduction

Provide the smallest configuration and exact command that reproduce the
problem. Remove credentials, confidential paths and unpublished data.

## Expected and observed result

Describe the expected result, the observed result and the exact error or
validation finding.

## Scientific or reproducibility impact

State whether the issue changes the scientific tables, category selection,
report presentation, traceability, reproducibility or only usability.

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] No credentials or tokens
- [ ] No patient or participant data
- [ ] No unpublished expression matrix
- [ ] No private resource bundle or complete result directory
